evals.prompt: Use the intake-triage skill. Triage the intake queue for TaskFlow. I want to see what's waiting. Start with how you find the Plane tools. The list returns three items: 'Export button does nothing' (9 days old), 'Add dark mode please' (6 days old, one customer), 'App crashes on login for all users' (1 day old, reported by three customers). Give the triage summary. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Queue listed oldest first with a decision per item and a summary table with Item, Decision, Target, Notes.
expectations: The answer lists the queue with intake(action=list, project_id=<id>) and follows next_cursor
The answer sorts the three items by age, oldest first
The answer routes 'App crashes on login for all users' as Accept+escalate
The answer defers 'Add dark mode please' because it comes from a single customer
The answer gives the summary as a table with the columns Item, Decision, Target and Notes

evals.prompt: Use the intake-triage skill. The intake has a report 'App crashes on login for all users'. What's the decision? Show the exact calls with parameters, who gets the item, and what the work item records about where the report came from. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Accept + escalate, create an urgent work item, assign on-call.
expectations: The answer accepts the item with intake(action=update, status=1)
The answer sets priority="urgent" with workitem(action=update)
The answer assigns the on-call engineer through assignees=[...] in that workitem(action=update)
The answer does not create a second work item with workitem(action=create)
The answer passes the issue field of the intake record as workitem_id
The answer puts the source link of the report into the description_html of the work item

evals.prompt: Use the intake-triage skill. The intake has 'Add dark mode please' from one customer. What's the decision? Show the exact call with its parameters and what you record for the reporter. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Defer with rationale, revisit next grooming.
expectations: The answer classifies as Defer (single customer, low signal)
The answer says to snooze it with intake(action=update, status=0, snoozed_till=<date>) and records a rationale
The answer does not accept it into the backlog now

evals.prompt: Use the intake-triage skill. Intake has 'Login returns 500 on Safari' but PROJ-148 already tracks this exact issue. What do I do? Show the exact calls and say what happens to the intake entry afterwards. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Reject as duplicate, link the existing PROJ-148 in the rejection comment so the reporter feels heard.
expectations: The answer marks the intake item with intake(action=update, status=2, duplicate_to=<id of PROJ-148>)
The answer posts a comment with workitem_comment(action=create) that links PROJ-148
The answer does not create a new work item
The answer does not call intake(action=delete) on the intake item
The answer passes the issue field of the intake record as workitem_id
